learnerStatement: Simulated learner. This review finds problems; it is not evidence that anyone learned.
learnerBoundary: Everyday numeracy, simple charts, comparison of numbers and familiar household objects; no domain-specific theory assumed.

observations.prediction: Selected 120 copies and locked it in.
observations.exploration: Append filled capacity one with zero copies. Grow copied one into capacity two. Fill then double at capacities two, four and eight accumulated three, seven and fifteen copies, with appends two, four and eight. Run to sixteen reached sixteen appends/fifteen copies and0.94 ratio. Start over restored zero/zero and capacity one; rerun reproduced sixteen/fifteen.
observations.reveal: Corrected to fifteen, summed one plus two plus four plus eight, explained each resize buys equally many copy-free appends and n appends cost n minus one copies at powers of two. Distinguished slow individual grow from cheap average.
observations.visual: Actual dark 1257 by 936 screenshots inspected. Numbered boxes and green copied subset, capacity text, copy sum and counters legible. After automatic rerun status caption still described last copy operation although all sixteen boxes filled; metrics consistent.
observations.previewIsolation: Preview banner said history and analytics are not saved.
observations.blinding: No source, builder notes or other reviews inspected.
